Interface TaskIdParamsMapper

All Known Implementing Classes:
TaskIdParamsMapperImpl
public interface TaskIdParamsMapper
Mapper for TaskIdParams from various gRPC request types.

Extracts task ID from resource name format "tasks/{id}" using ResourceNameParser.
